names: Saccharin and its sodium, potassium and calcium salts

more_info.overview: E954 covers saccharin and its sodium, calcium and potassium salts; the specified sweetener preparations differ in solubility. It provides sweetness when added to the food or used in a table-top sweetener preparation. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. Only a limited amount dissolves in water, according to the specification.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; fruit nectars as defined by Directive 2001/112/EC and vegetable nectars and similar products; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.daily_intake: 9 mg saccharin/kg body weight/day, expressed as free imide (EFSA, 2024).
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use exposure stayed below the limit.
The review identified potential genotoxic impurities associated with one manufacturing route and requested improved specifications.
